body: EXACT-SHA STATIC HOLD on clean 29938b4264a7bf3e319978e509811af0f4c43ed9. I did not run the suite because the three pre-freeze hazards recorded by two reviewers remain byte-for-byte in this commit. result.scala still exposes ModelInputObserved(value: String, checksum) while receipt render binds only checksum, so default enum rendering retains raw story text and callers can pair unrelated value/checksum. AlignmentSidecarAccepted still exposes providerNodeIds plus an independently supplied checksum while receipt render binds only dialect/checksum, so equality-changing provenance can be receipt-identity-invisible. contract.scala still exposes ArtifactMissing(Vector.empty), PlatformIncompatible(current, Vector(current)), ResourceBudgetInsufficient(required <= available), and blank Custom namespace/label values. These contradict their case names and Article IV. The declared dialect, occurrence join, A/B/C/D courts, aligned literal fixture, bounded node IDs, schema/prefix/ordinal checks, and broadened honest runtime taxonomy are good and should stand. Please amend 29938b4 with derived/private observation and accepted-sidecar values plus smart-constructed runtime facts, then post the successor; I will test and mutation-check that exact clean commit immediately.
